notes: Oracle-layout baseline: predicted bboxes are copied verbatim from the ground-truth annotation. This measures DeepL's text-quality ceiling, NOT DeepL's end-to-end document-translation product. The true DeepL Documents API runner (operating on PDFs) is deferred to v0.2 because the v0.1 sample dataset is PNG-based. Total characters processed: ~6,000 across 25 doc x lang-pair batches, comfortably inside the DeepL free-tier 500k chars/mo quota.
